items.title: digitisation_sim_harness reads the shipped world continued to 1960 beside a 1660 control, and says on its face what each of the thirteen readings is
items.design:
WHY. BL-982 (Digitisation readings) generates at epoch 0 and reads the 1660 close: 3 measured, 1 partial, 9 n/a (NR-886 item 7). Its recorded baseline (6/16, 0, 12/16, 0.48/0.74/0.82) and built exe predate wave A. The measure-before-mechanism slice gives every reading a real 1960 baseline before any Digitisation mechanism is admitted.

WHAT IT CAN AND CANNOT MOVE, said on the face. Real 1960 values: reading 5's present half (mixed cities) and reading 7 (far trade, as standing flows). Newly measurable from existing state: reading 10 (subjects at 1660 and 1960, plus subject_freed events after 1660 split by whether a war freed them) and reading 9's urban half (urban share of population at 1660 and 1960). Inputs moved only: reading 1 and reading 6's proxy. STRUCTURAL ZEROS, printed as such and never counted measured: reading 3 (the recipe band follows epoch_year, ancient at epoch 0) and reading 8's region half (Stage 4 lag is computed only for a settlement stop >= 1700). Polity industrial crossings still move and are printed. n/a until their mechanism: 2, 4, 11, 12, 13, 5's concentration half, 9's cross-border half. The far-trade reading of BL-1006 (haulage_measure) runs epoch_year 1960, the superseded arc; the face records that it moves with the epoch flip, not here.

THE WORK. `--through <year>` sets exploration_stop_year (default 1660; this sprint runs 1960), epoch_year stays 0. Per seed: the world through --through, as today up to the applied search winner; a 1660 control re-run from the captured fixture (exploration_sweep.cpp:566-590, reading fx.works); the control's fingerprint counters must equal the library fingerprint from BL-1026, which proves the extended run agrees with the shipped world at 1660. Every face line names its surface and its year. SUMMARY counts measured, partial, structural zero and n/a separately (today it counts reading 3 as measured). Handoff violations from generation_report are printed per seed, and a seed with one reports no reading as measured. Output also to a per-seed JSON via --out.

DONE WHEN. The sixteen library seeds read at 1660 and 1960, per seed; every control matches its fingerprint; no src/world change; the SUMMARY and every structural zero honest. NR-886 item 7 is answered by the run and noted there.

RUN CONDITIONS (sprint 43, all items): one lane, serial, in the main session; Release harness builds via `bash tools/verify/build_lua_harness.sh <name>` into build_gen/verify, never %TEMP%; timings on a quiet machine with the build tree quoted; never write over a tracked sweep artefact (use --out). No item in this sprint changes a shipped world.
